title: Artifact type (CONTRACT.md 3.3, operations profile)
description: One entry of the description's top-level artifact_types: a type the tool's ports name, the versions of its record the tool reads, how it leaves the workspace and whether the tool previews it. `image` is the contract's and is never listed.

type.description: `location` or the tool's own `<tool.name>:<Name>`; never `image`, which the contract defines whole.

schema_versions.description: The versions of the type's record the tool reads; it writes the newest.

portable.description: bundle: a file the tool writes and reads whole; json: a JSON document; none: it cannot leave its workspace yet (5.1).

preview.description: Whether the tool draws an artifact of the type as an image for people (4.7).

type.description: A shared type (`image`, `location`) or a tool's own, `<tool.name>:<Name>`.
